data.summary: Sportverein Beispielau 1911 e.V. informs Johanna Beispielacker that the direct debit for the 2026 family membership fee was returned by her bank and asks her to transfer the outstanding €172.50 (fee plus a return-debit fee) by 3 December 2026.
data.explanation: Your sports club tried to collect the 2026 family membership fee by direct debit (Lastschrift), but your bank returned the payment, so the club now wants you to pay the fee plus a return-debit fee yourself by bank transfer. Pay the total amount shown to the club's account by the stated due date to settle the account and avoid further reminders. If your bank details have changed, send the club a new SEPA mandate so this doesn't happen again. This is a private club letter, not a government notice, so no statutory appeal deadlines apply here.

items.title: Pay the outstanding 2026 membership fee
items.action: Transfer the outstanding amount to the club's account by the due date, or send a new SEPA mandate if your bank details have changed.
